what: Fresh clone of https://github.com/ofitzharding/sq19 at v1.0.0; bash scripts/fetch.sh (certificate sources downloaded from the public release, hash-checked); python3 scripts/verify.py --kernel-replay. No precompiled project objects were used; only the pinned Mathlib build cache.

comparison_with_research_build.note: All generated certificate modules are byte-identical. The differing modules are hand-written ones, which this route builds with Lake while the research build used direct lean invocations and caches from separate sessions.
